ios.desc:
UX Assist provides workflows for designers comprising of design activities related to user research, collaboration, facilitation, interaction design, and usability testing. It's the first app of its kind that has grouped UX activities into 16 unique workflows based on the type of product you're working on - an optimum viable product, a minimum viable product, an enterprise product, and a data-driven product.

You can know about more than 80 design-related activities comprising of UX cards with bite-sized information about each activity.

quotes.text: I made a simple iOS app for designers called as UX Assist. It has been around for 6 years now. I’m just happy that it’s out there and helping some folks now and then. [UX Assist](https://apps.apple.com/in/app/ux-assist/id1491649877)
